how: We read the website of every Orlando wedding venue listed on Lazo (158 listings, 121 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: officiant services, micro-wedding package sellers, hair-and-makeup bundles, event production firms, a caterer's venue list, and a civic center that leads with weekday meeting space. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: What is the rain plan for an outdoor ceremony? Summer afternoons here bring thunderstorms, so ask to see the covered or indoor backup, not just hear about it.
Is the venue fee for exclusive use of the property, and how many hours does it cover, including setup and teardown?
Which vendors are included or required in the package, and what can I bring in myself?

picks.name: Cypress Creek Farmhouse
picks.blurb: A rustic-elegant venue in Astatula with crystal chandeliers and golden-hour light across the lake, built where southern hospitality meets laid-back elegance. The owner brings over 25 years in hospitality and events and offers to guide couples through every step.

picks.name: Bella Cosa Wedding Venue
picks.blurb: Bella Cosa in Lake Wales began as the Lake Pierce Club in 1925, later became The Bonaire hotel, and is now an exclusive-use lakeside wedding venue. The packages and prices are in a downloadable brochure, and the site promises no hidden costs.

picks.name: Casani Estates Event Venue
picks.blurb: Casani Estates is a privately owned lakefront venue on Twin Lake in Groveland, set within more than 100 acres of pine forest about 35 miles from Orlando. All-inclusive packages with pricing are published, with reception space for 100 and a maximum capacity over 250.

picks.name: The Place: Weddings and Events
picks.blurb: The Place in Oviedo is a family-owned venue created by people who had worked extensively with Orlando theme parks and wanted an affordable place for weddings. Inclusive pricing is the pitch, and the site says it saves couples thousands.

picks.name: Rustic Grace Barn
picks.blurb: Founded in 2022, Rustic Grace Barn near Davenport offers outdoor garden ceremony spaces and all-inclusive wedding packages. The venue describes a timeless blend of rustic charm for everything from intimate ceremonies to larger celebrations.

picks.name: Let's Get Married Orlando
picks.blurb: Let's Get Married Orlando is a family-owned private backyard wedding destination specializing in intimate, curated weddings and private backyard ceremonies. All-inclusive packages are laid out in a downloadable brochure with pricing and amenities.

picks.name: Hidden Barn Venue
picks.blurb: Hidden Barn in Apopka is an all-inclusive barn venue with rustic spaces and covered ceremony options. Its most popular choice is the All-Inclusive Package, which the site says provides everything needed for the day from catering onward in one price.

picks.name: The Carriage House at Vedder Farms
picks.blurb: A classic white barn-style venue in the rolling hills near Leesburg, run by a family who share their farm with couples. The package lists 12 hours of use on the day, a climate-controlled space with three crystal chandeliers and two getting-ready suites.

picks.name: Celebration Gardens
picks.blurb: Celebration Gardens in Winter Park has been a gathering place for weddings since 1990, when it began as English Gardens. Venue rentals and wedding packages are priced on the site, for anything from an intimate ceremony to a 300-guest celebration.

picks.name: Historic Venue 1902
picks.blurb: Once a century-old grammar school, Historic Venue 1902 in Sanford is a family-owned venue restored for weddings, with outdoor garden space alongside the historic rooms. The approach, in their words, is weddings that feel personal, relaxed and well cared for.

picks.name: Chapel Valley Farm
picks.blurb: Chapel Valley Farm is a family-owned 25-acre property in Eustis with a quaint chapel, an outdoor ceremony space under oak and pine hammock, a covered outdoor reception area, a poolside cocktail spot and a working windmill. No ballrooms or banquet halls, by design.

picks.name: Maison & Jardin – Wedding & Event Venue Orlando, FL
picks.blurb: Maison & Jardin in Altamonte Springs has hosted Central Florida events since 1958, with French-inspired indoor and outdoor wedding spaces. Full catering with professional chefs comes with the venue, and the staff is described as experienced and committed to the day.
